source_scope.context_limit: Only the named boundary strips; do not analyze other adjacent-page text or diagrams. If insufficient, checkpoint a missing-context blocker for a new scoped session.

Remove only four assigned placeholder memberships; retain their old registry entries. Preserve the existing page-25 context record, its evidence and links. Append new assigned regions/evidence and narrowly scoped context regions; no ancestor baseline or report substitution.
source_scope.evidence_generation: Generate every new region/component crop, text and image serially in the current Python process using installed tooling. No multiprocessing, worker pools or external service. Recheck source and input hashes before and after.

replays.requirement: Run two separate complete independent regenerations from the pinned author input and persisted registry into absent directories. Pin parent region, box and fresh evidence per component. Nested component observations have zero additional inventory denominator and do not create overlapping inventory boxes.

Include assigned_range_entry and assigned_range_exit with physical_page 25 and 28 respectively, explicit observation, exact endpoint IDs and page-24/page-29 context-only locators. Empty prior boundary projection is unknown, not absence.

Preserve nonassigned unprocessed gaps; count exclusions and uncertainty visibly. Context contributes zero denominator. Geometry, substantive accounting, transcription, descriptive/formal semantics and executable readiness remain separate.
report_contracts.source-pins.json: Pin actual accepted baseline inventory/registry, every current report, original source/provenance, original-page render evidence, every fresh region/component evidence input and two replay outputs. report_contracts.toolchain.json: Pin actual interpreter, bundled process_pythonpath (both repo/src and bundled site-packages), process_path_prefix, resolved Poppler binaries and hashes, library/engine versions and rendering settings. report_contracts.preservation-report.json: Compare the complete baseline and result internally. Prove every nonassigned page and region, all inherited evidence/links, existing registry entries and bindings remain unchanged; assigned-page geometry/source identity unchanged. Show exactly four placeholder memberships retired, no other deletion, and new IDs/links/evidence restricted to the assigned/context scope. Freeze counts and hashes without dumping unassigned source text.
report_contracts.replay-report.json: Pin both complete independent replay command logs, all input/output hashes, complete target-set equality, component equality, stable registry identity and normalized comparison results; no partial/sampled replay.
report_contracts.validation-report.json: Freeze exact commands, exits and report/log hashes, full/task/context denominators, artifact validation and unresolved limits; green structure is not human semantic acceptance.
